name: prepare_workspace
description: Check a repository out into your private workspace, on a fresh branch from origin/<base_branch> (its default branch when you leave it out). Call it first, once; again is harmless and keeps your changes. Another repository is added next to it, and the tools then take `repo`. Only for a repository the person named in their messages; otherwise it refuses, and you ask. To carry on with a branch this conversation pushed (a rework), pass it as `branch`: open_pull_request then updates its pull request.

base_branch.description: Branch to start from and to open the pull request against, e.g. main. Leave out for the repository's default branch.

branch.description: A branch that commit_and_push reported earlier in this conversation (agent/...), to carry on with it and update its pull request. Leave out to start a new branch.
